appearance.sliderSizeHint: Scales the sliders together with their area: icons get smaller while the number of rows stays the same (80% is the default).
appearance.sliderSpeedHint: How fast mods, textures and other items fly by (80% is the default).
appearance.sliderBorderHint: Width of the area where the sliders move: 50% is the default; higher values make the area wider, lower values narrower.
appearance.glassFieldSizeHint: Width of the glass panel, expanding inward from the selected tile edge.
appearance.motionHint: "On hover" moves the sliders only on the tile under the cursor, which reduces load.
appearance.dockHint: You can also drag the panel by an empty area: every edge has two halves, and the far half drops the panel mirrored.
appearance.alignHint: Mirrored fully inverts the content order: on a vertical bar the logo goes to the bottom and the tools to the top. Also chosen by dropping the panel into the far half of an edge.

tileStyleHints.standard: Text at the tile edge with the sliders next to it.
tileStyleHints.stylish: The sliders fill almost the whole tile, while the title and icon sit in a corner on a fading backdrop.
tileStyleHints.glass: Sliders fill the tile while the icon and title stay at the selected edge on a translucent glass panel.

appearance.glassBlurHint: Controls blur of the sliders beneath the glass panel. 0% disables blur.
appearance.tileSideHint: "Automatic" follows the tile's position on screen: left tiles keep text on the left, right tiles on the right.
appearance.tileTextPosHint: "Auto-detect" puts the text in the bottom-left or bottom-right corner depending on the tile's position.
appearance.sliderLayoutHint: Choose how the slider area uses its available height. Stretch adds rows to fill the area.
appearance.lockPanelsHint: Prevents dragging either panel to another edge.
appearance.gameDockHint: Drag the header by an empty area onto an edge: the top and bottom edges have two halves (the far half mirrors the content), the side edges put the info in one row at the top and float the play button at the bottom corner — mirrored on the right side. You can also pick the position here.
appearance.disableInstanceQuickActionsHint: Hides the edit and delete buttons on instances in the sidebar. These actions remain available in the context menu.
appearance.sliderGridSizeHint: Spacing between icons in the static grid, in pixels.
appearance.sliderGapHint: Spacing between icons in the moving slider.
appearance.sliderHideTextHint: Show icons only, without labels or extra empty space.

slide1.title: Welcome to MoonlightLauncher!
slide1.desc: A modern, fast Minecraft launcher. Manage multiple instances, mods, Java configurations and more. Let's take a quick tour!

slide2.title: Which account would you like to use?
slide2.desc: Choose an account type to set it up now. You can add more accounts or switch the active account from your profile later.

accounts.later: You can also click Next and set up your account later.

slide3.title: Your Instances
slide3.desc: Instances are separate Minecraft installations. View and select your instances here. Each one can have its own version, mods and configuration.

slide4.title: Create Instance
slide4.desc: Use this button to create a new instance. Choose a name, version, loader (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge) and a custom icon.

slide5.title: Version Manager
slide5.desc: Download Minecraft versions here. Get official releases, snapshots, alphas and Fabric versions to use in your instances.

slide6.title: Settings
slide6.desc: The Settings panel has three sections: Launcher, Minecraft and Java. Let's look at each one.

slide7.title: Settings Sections
slide7.desc: Use the tabs to navigate between Launcher (language, themes, updates), Minecraft (RAM, versions, console) and Java (runtimes, arguments).

slide8.title: Java Configuration
slide8.desc: Manage Java 8, 17, 21 and 25 runtimes here. Install Java automatically from the launcher or use an existing installation. You can also configure JVM arguments and environment variables.

slide9.title: License
slide9.desc: MoonlightLauncher is free software released under the GNU General Public License v3.0 only (GPL-3.0-only).
